names.description: Collision-prone cloud names set in full (not Terraform variables; docs/design.md, "Names, labels and tags"). This chart gives none.

namePrefix.description: Optional convenience (not a Terraform variable). The chart gives no cloud names, so it changes nothing. A DNS label.

labels.description: Kubernetes labels on every object; an unprefixed key is also checked as a Google Cloud label.

tags.description: Cloud labels on every resource (Google Cloud labels: lower-case letters, digits, _ and -).

deletion_policy.description: Not a module variable. PREVENT is refused (no Config Connector equivalent).

bindings.description: Map of role (key) and list of members (value) to add the IAM policies/bindings

conditional_bindings.description: List of maps of role and respective conditions, and the members to add the IAM policies/bindings

folders.description: Folders list to add the IAM policies/bindings (folders/<number> or <number>)

mode.description: Mode for adding the IAM policies/bindings, additive and authoritative
